notes.title: Turbo Bullets Demo OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p]It's official! We've released a demo version of Turbo Bullets. It's been over two years in the making.[/p][p]Play and celebrate with us! Rockets and mortars ready? Full speed ahead!!!![/p]

notes.title: Turbo Bullets team is heading to Digital Dragons 2025
notes.content: Turbo Bullets team will be there on Digital Dragons 2025 conference in Cracow! Come, visit our booth and play the demo with us!

notes.title: January major update! Jumps, shortcuts, optional retro mode and new physics!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45070407/b659fbf4d6e1d1961c51ff7312cb5bd52d4e038a.png[/img]

January major content update! Game build have been enhanced with shortcuts jumping ramps, optional retro rendering mode ( work-in-progress ) new, updated physics, and many other changes, that came into  the game! Our community voted, that they want to see shortcuts in the game to make up for lost seconds. To use the shortcut, the player will have to hit the ramp while driving above the required speed and be careful not to fall off the track, or touch the explosive barrels, as this will result in instant death. We want to give you a demo version for testing soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Turbo Bullets runs hot like a napalm! Updates! Updates! Updates!
notes.content:
We know you can't wait, but be patient, because today we want to announce, that we have something special for ya -  a public DEMO BUILD is coming soon to STEAM!!! You will be given an oppurtunity to test out the game on 3 example maps, so make sure you are ready to roll once the stuff gets public! 

Get ready for a wild ride - this game is MENTAL!!!

Devs

notes.title: TURBO BULLETS GETS PARTIAL SUPPORT FOR KEYBOARD, MOUSE AND GAMEPAD
notes.content:
Hey! We wanted to tell you, that we have just hit a development milestone and implemented a partial support ( and full "action support" ) for controllers. Now you can play the way you like - keyboard solo, keyboard + mouse or solo gamepad. :))) 

Want to know more about upcoming game - then see you on discord!

The Dev. team

notes.title: BOOM! Registration for 13.09.2024 closed beta tests starts now!
notes.content:
Dear Followers. 

On 13.09.2024 we are going to launch the first round of Turbo Bullets closed BETA tests. You will be given an access to development - demo version. After series of tests we will ask you share your opinion and thoughts on Discord group. Places are limited, so don't hesitate and sign up for tests via our official Discord channel. We can't wait to rock your life!
